task: Extend trusted main-advance overlap proof with a narrowly bounded exact-create category so a create operation already present on descendant main is safe only when the trusted executor proves the target Git blob and file mode exactly equal the operation's sealed immutable source identity.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The U03 exact conflict-resolution transaction must land immutable fixture-25 on main together with the reviewed modify-conflict resolution. The release-unit materializer already treats a create as ALREADY_APPLIED when the target blob equals the sealed source blob. However the earlier trusted-main-advance guard from PR #1092 intentionally classifies every intended create overlap as unsafe before materialization, so replay would stop at RELEASE_UNIT_MAIN_DRIFT even for byte-identical immutable content. The missing capability is not general create overlap allowance; it is an exact Git-object attestation category produced only by the trusted default-branch executor and independently structurally validated by the core runtime.
observableOutcomes: Trusted main-advance proof exposes an explicit exactCreateOverlapFiles category and exact per-file blob/mode attestation for safe create overlaps.

A create overlap is exact only when there is exactly one declared create operation for the file, the operation has sealed source identity, and target `toSha:file` blob plus mode exactly equal the sealed source blob plus mode.
Exact-create overlap is not included in unsafeOverlapFiles and may proceed to mandatory fresh semantic reevaluation/materialization.
A create overlap with missing/unsealed source, target missing, different blob, different file mode, ambiguous duplicate declaration or generated/regenerate semantics remains unsafe and blocks.
Delete, rename and other non-modify/non-exact-create intended overlaps remain unsafe.
The core proof validator recomputes operation/category expectations from manifest and rejects fabricated exact-create classifications or identity fields.
Existing dependency overlap and exactly-one-modify overlap behavior remains unchanged.
The U03 resolution transaction can later add exact immutable fixture-25 without creating a new main-drift blocker.
unresolvedRisks: Accepting create overlap from filename alone would silently allow unrelated target content.
Checking blob but not file mode would miss executable/mode drift.
Trusting caller-supplied exactCreateOverlapFiles without Git-object attestation would turn the category into a bypass.
Allowing generated/regenerate create semantics through ordinary sealed-blob equality could bypass generator authority.
Core and GitHub classifiers could diverge and accept a forged proof.
A duplicate create declaration could make operation identity ambiguous.

in: Add exact-create overlap classification and Git-object attestation to scripts/release-unit-github-runtime.mjs.
Extend the core main-advance proof contract validator in scripts/lib/shoperation-release-unit-runtime.mjs with the same explicit category and structural identity checks.
Update production-surface regression coverage for exact create PASS and all fail-closed variants.
Preserve existing modify/dependency overlap semantics exactly.
out: No generic permission for create overlap.
No U03 fixture/test/receipt implementation in this prerequisite PR.
No immutable source or release-state mutation.
No storefront, template, Supabase or deployment change.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This proof decides whether main history may already contain an intended create without blocking successor execution. A false positive could authorize unrelated content; the only safe exception is exact immutable Git-object identity under the trusted executor.

acceptanceCriteria: Proof producer records exactCreateOverlapFiles separately from dependencyOverlapFiles, modifyOverlapFiles and unsafeOverlapFiles.
For each exact create, proof records file, sourceBlobSha, sourceFileMode, targetBlobSha and targetFileMode.
Producer reads target identity from exact `toSha` Git objects, not working-tree content.

A safe exact create requires operation.operation=create, exactly one declaration for the file, no generated/regenerate semantics, source.mode=sealed, valid source blob and source file mode, and exact target blob/mode equality.
Core validator requires exact category arrays and exact identity array coherence with the sealed manifest operation.
Core validator rejects exact-create proof entries when the file is not a declared create or source identity does not match proof.
Wrong target blob, wrong mode, missing target, missing/unsealed source and duplicate create declarations all remain RELEASE_UNIT_MAIN_DRIFT.
Delete, rename and generated/regenerate overlaps remain unsafe.
Existing dependency and modify overlap tests remain PASS.
Exact-head CI, Completion Truth and Lifecycle Closure pass before merge.
invariants: Only trusted exact Git-object equality can convert a create overlap from unsafe to safe.
Source blob and file mode remain immutable authority for exact-create classification.
Proof categories are mutually coherent and unsafe overlap remains blocking.
No operation scope is widened by exact-create attestation.
Core validator does not independently access mutable working-tree state.

failureModes: Producer classifies exact create from manifest without reading target Git object.
Producer reads the branch working tree rather than exact toSha.
Core validator accepts a fabricated exact-create category.
File mode is omitted from attestation.
Generated create is incorrectly treated as ordinary sealed create.
Existing modify overlap becomes stricter or looser unintentionally.
edgeCases: target blob exactly equals sealed source blob and mode 100644
same blob but target mode differs
target blob differs by one byte
two create declarations for one file
create operation has generated mode regenerate
file is both intended and dependency

alternatives.summary: Allow only exact sealed create overlap proven by trusted `toSha` blob/mode identity and bind it into the signed proof categories.
alternatives.reason: Matches existing materializer idempotency while preserving immutable source authority and fail-closed behavior.

alternatives.summary: Treat every create overlap as safe and defer all checks to materialization.
alternatives.reason: Would allow unrelated main content to bypass the main-advance boundary and shifts a preventable integrity check too late.

alternatives.summary: Allow create overlap when target blob matches source blob but ignore file mode.
alternatives.reason: Mode drift is part of the sealed source identity and can materially change execution semantics.

alternatives.summary: Special-case fixture-25 or the U03 releaseUnitId in the overlap guard.
alternatives.reason: Would hard-code rehearsal data instead of fixing the generic exact-idempotent create invariant.

specialistReviews.finding: Create overlap was deliberately unsafe in PR #1092 and must not be reopened generically.
specialistReviews.resolution: Introduce a separate exact-create category that requires immutable Git-object equality; ordinary create remains unsafe.

specialistReviews.finding: Target content must not be trusted from branch labels or caller metadata.
specialistReviews.resolution: Trusted executor resolves exact `toSha:file` blob/mode and proof binds them to sealed operation source identity.

specialistReviews.finding: The U03 fixture-25 resolution case is safe only if the target object is byte/mode identical to immutable source.
specialistReviews.resolution: Require sourceBlobSha===targetBlobSha and sourceFileMode===targetFileMode for every exact-create proof identity.

specialistReviews.finding: U01/U02 are closed; U03 resolution cannot land fixture-25 until this overlap invariant is represented.
specialistReviews.resolution: Merge generic prerequisite first, then reproject the already Plan-approved U03 resolution transaction onto fresh main.

specialistReviews.finding: The prior operation-aware overlap tests intentionally assert non-modify overlap BLOCK and therefore lack the exact-idempotent create boundary case.
specialistReviews.resolution: Replace the broad create assertion with exact-safe and inexact-fail-closed matrix while preserving other unsafe operation cases.

challenge.scenario: One sealed create overlaps and target toSha blob/mode exactly equal source.
challenge.finding: Current classifier blocks even though materializer would return alreadyApplied.
challenge.resolution: Classify as exactCreate overlap and continue to fresh reevaluation.

challenge.scenario: Target blob differs while file name and operation type match.
challenge.finding: Could be unrelated or stale content.
challenge.resolution: Keep unsafe and block main advance.

challenge.scenario: Blob matches but target file mode differs.
challenge.resolution: Keep unsafe; exact mode equality required.

challenge.scenario: Manifest source identity is missing or unsealed.
Two create declarations target the same file.
Generated/regenerate create target happens to match a blob.
challenge.resolution: Keep generated create unsafe in this capability.

challenge.scenario: Proof claims exactCreate for a modify/delete/foreign file.
challenge.finding: Forged category could bypass unsafe classification.
challenge.resolution: Core validator recomputes declared operation type/source and rejects proof.

challenge.scenario: Exact create file is also a required dependency.
challenge.finding: Intended operation authority must take precedence.
challenge.resolution: Classify once as exactCreate, never dependency overlap.

challenge.finding: New category must not alter legacy proof shape semantically.
challenge.resolution: Emit empty exactCreate categories/identities and retain all existing PASS behavior.

proofPlan: Commit this plan only and require Plan Before Code PASS before runtime edits.
Extend trusted producer and core validator together so proof categories cannot diverge.
Add regression matrix for exact create PASS, target blob/mode mismatch, missing/unsealed source, duplicate create, generated create, forged proof, and unchanged modify/dependency cases.
Merge only after exact PR-head SUCCESS and green main CI.
Then reproject the U03 exact conflict-resolution plan from fresh main and continue its separately governed resolution.

requirements.requirement: Trusted main-advance reconciliation may accept an intended create overlap only when exact target Git blob and file mode are proven identical to the operation's sealed immutable source identity.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Create overlap with different blob or mode may not pass trusted main advance.
Create overlap without sealed immutable source identity may not pass.
Core validation may not accept fabricated exact-create categories or identities.

notes: Prerequisite discovered before implementing the already Plan-approved U03 exact conflict resolution. Current U03 resolution must add immutable fixture-25 to main, but PR #1092's operation-aware overlap deliberately marks all create overlap unsafe. Materializer semantics already prove exact source-identical create as ALREADY_APPLIED. This task aligns trusted main-advance proof with that narrow idempotent invariant without making ordinary create overlap safe.
